result.summary: Adds CMake installation rules for bash and fish completion scripts alongside their corresponding binary components. Targets declare available completion scripts via new flags in `install_binary_component`, and installs can be toggled using `-DINSTALL_BASH_COMPLETIONS` and `-DINSTALL_FISH_COMPLETIONS`.
result.problem: Packagers and users installing via CMake currently have to manually locate and copy shell completion scripts from `contrib/completions/` into system directories, as `cmake --install` omits them.
evidence: Author states: 'Packagers currently need to copy shell completion scripts from contrib/completions/ into the appropriate system directories. Install the scripts alongside their corresponding binaries with cmake --install, including when installing a binary by component.'
result.card: Adds CMake install rules and configuration options to automatically install bash and fish shell completions alongside binary components during cmake --install. Currently, packagers and users must manually copy completion scripts out of contrib/completions into system directories. The PR resolves issue #34714 by tying script installation to individual binary components following the existing manpage installation pattern. It has no dependencies.
